title: If nobody asked for it, you do not have a business yet
caption: If nobody asked for it, you do not have a business yet. Listen for the sentence I hate that I have to.

scenes.text:
If nobody asked,
it is not a business.
scenes.voice: If nobody asked for it, you do not have a business yet.

scenes.text:
A product nobody
requested is a hobby.
scenes.voice: A product nobody requested is a hobby.

scenes.text:
That is fine.
Call it a hobby.
scenes.voice: That is fine. Call it a hobby.
If you want money, start with a complaint.
Listen for the sentence: I hate that I have to.

scenes.text:
Free users lie.
Paying users talk.
scenes.voice: Free users lie. Paying users tell the truth.
Save this before you design another feature. Find the complaint first.
